message.content: According to the band's discussion on July 3, 2026, Yuriko proposes that the band can practice playing "Take Me Home Country Roads" by John Denver this weekend. This suggestion comes as a response to a previous conversation where Wolfgang suggested sticking to their usual Sunday jam session to focus on regular practices. Yuriko's idea is to introduce a new song to create a relaxed vibe for their upcoming community performance, which aligns with the description of their Sunday Jam Session as a recurring musical gathering where they plan to experiment with the new app and song arrangements. This proposal is well-received by the rest of the band members, indicating a consensus to experiment with this particular song during their next gathering.
